problem: Exact deterministic discovery fingerprints can diverge for semantically equivalent worker proposals when target/problem wording differs, so create-if-absent pins prevent byte/canonical collisions but do not prevent duplicate candidate work across distinct fingerprints.
acceptance: semantically equivalent proposals with different exact fingerprints compile into one candidate duplicate cluster while every source proposal and pin remains immutable
material differences in owner scope privacy desired output dependency or falsification prevent false merge unless an explicit evidence-backed equivalence rationale exists
cluster disposition is machine-auditable and never self-promotes a proposal to READY Current Human Accepted or Served
tests include paraphrase duplicates and adversarial near-duplicates
title: Cross-fingerprint semantic duplicate clustering canary
mission: Build and verify a candidate Planner-side semantic clustering step over immutable worker proposals. It must detect semantically equivalent work even when deterministic exact fingerprints differ because wording differs, preserve every source proposal/pin and lineage edge, fail safely on material owner/scope/privacy/output/dependency/falsification differences, and emit an auditable duplicate-cluster disposition without promoting anything to READY or product authority.

regression_prevention.reason: Exact create-if-absent pins only serialize one canonical identity. Without a second-stage semantic cluster, paraphrased discoveries can become duplicate candidate work and later duplicate execution pressure.

unblock_value.reason: The proposal contract already requires Planner-side semantic clustering while preserving source lineage; implementing and falsifying that step closes a known gap between exact pinning and semantic deduplication.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Automatic semantic clustering prevents the human or guide from manually recognizing paraphrased duplicate proposals during large identical-worker waves.

fail_if: two paraphrased proposals for the same bounded work remain separate executable candidates without an explicit non-equivalence rationale
same visible symptom with materially different owner scope privacy output dependency or falsification is merged solely by text similarity
clustering rewrites or deletes source proposal or pin evidence
a cluster disposition upgrades any source proposal to READY Current Human Accepted or Served
falsification.pass_if: A replay set containing paraphrase duplicates and adversarial near-duplicates yields stable candidate clusters with preserved immutable lineage, explicit merge/non-merge rationale, no false authority promotion, and deterministic machine-auditable output.
